notablePrerequisites:
Dargo is one of your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast
description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}.
If Dargo costs more than {2}{R} to cast, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/R}.
Repeat step 5 as necessary.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat step 8 until you have {4}{B} available.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
